text:
rachael: Heads up  we need one-paragraph guidance on what adapters may forward into Private runtimes. goal: avoid PII and reduce blast radius while keeping debugability.
omid: Current reality: adapters forward x-rw-trace, x-rw-route, x-customer-meta (freeform). x-customer-meta sometimes contains user hashes and flags.
yusuf: My quick proposal: adopt a three-tier profile: "minimal", "ops", "debug". minimal = trace+route only. ops = hashed tenant + allowlisted meta keys. debug = clear tenant+meta, only with timebox and explicit admin grant.
rachael: For hashed tenant we should standardize algorithm (sha256 hex) and salt per-deployment to avoid cross-tenant correlation. store salt in control plane and rotate.
omid: Sealing the tenant with KMS (sealed_blob) is the gold path for Dedicated where latency tolerance exists. but add perf numbers in PR before mandating.
yusuf: Also: adapters must validate meta keys against a policy decision. Instead of pushing policy logic into every adapter, publish a tiny validation lib from control plane (stable semver). adapters call it; if control plane unavailable, use a local conservative fallback (minimal).
policy-bot: Note: policy change requiring clear-tenant must create audit event with admin id, reason, timestamp; enforce MFA for grant.
rachael: Manifest change idea:
"telemetry": "profile: minimal|ops|debug; debug_window: 60m; clear_tenant_allowed: false; sample_rate_cap: 0.1"
omid: Backwards compat: adapters that don't parse new manifest act as minimal. rollout plan: default all existing deployments to ops with hashed tenant for 2 weeks, run canary on Dedicated for sealed KMS path.
yusuf: Testing: perf harness for sealing/unsealing, sampling behavior, and a fuzz test ensuring no meta keys matching /user|email|ssn/ are forwarded.
rachael: Action items: 1) Omid write manifest PR + migration notes. 2) Yusuf spec for validation lib + TTL for cached decisions. 3) I I'll draft audit + MFA requirements. 4) Ops run perf on KMS seal path and report numbers.
omid: I'll open PR today. if no objections we'll adopt this for next release. :thumbsup:
yusuf: +1
policy-bot: Created issue ARCH-telemetry-profiles and assigned to architecture milestone.
